selected_proposals.selection_rationale: Primary exploitation of the strong GEN020-M01 evidence: implements full bounded intra-layer PaiNN-style vector norm/dot feedback into scalar and vector channels, directly targeting the source unit's ISO17 energy/gap weakness while retaining source recovery through zero-start gates.

Lower-risk scalar-only ablation of the same M01 mechanism; isolates whether invariant vector contractions improve scalar energy channels without disturbing vector_state, protecting the already-strong RMD17 force behavior.

Late-layer placement ablation for the PaiNN mixer; tests whether the source only needs a final low-disruption vector-conditioned scalar correction rather than recurrent feedback throughout message passing.

Selects a shared recurrent PaiNN mixer as a mechanism-form jump: it keeps the evidence-backed intra-layer feedback pathway but changes parameter sharing and recurrence to probe stability and variance with fewer free parameters.

Tests a bounded capacity/mechanism interaction by pairing the M01 mixer with slightly finer radial resolution; useful because generation_019 scale calibration was neutral, so the next bottleneck may be distance resolution plus vector-conditioned feedback.

Selects one objective-interaction jump, not a pure training-only diagnostic: keeps the M01 mechanism while testing whether a slightly less force-dominated late objective is needed to convert vector-norm feedback into ISO17 energy/gap gains.

Backward-simplify diagnostic: removes or freezes the source's body-order side branch to test whether it dilutes the successful TP signal and whether future PaiNN-mixer variants should avoid that complexity.

Exact source replicate control is required to calibrate generation_020 variance around generation_019/proposal_003 before attributing small Q_total, energy, force, or gap changes to the selected edits.

selection_policy: Prioritize the new strong PaiNN intra-layer vector norm/dot mixing evidence while preserving interpretability and benchmark semantics. Select three clean M01 exploit ablations, three broader jump variants spanning shared recurrence, radial-resolution interaction, and objective interaction, one backward-simplify diagnostic for source branch complexity, and one exact source replicate control. Defer the training-only diagnostic and weaker readout-only wildcard so the batch remains mechanism-centric and avoids excessive objective/readout confounding.
selected_mechanism_axes: GEN020-M01 full intra-layer PaiNN vector norm/dot scalar-vector feedback
Scalar-only and late-layer ablations for M01 placement and feedback-path isolation
Late objective schedule plus M01 energy/gap interaction

omitted_proposals.reason: Training-only ISO17 energy-tail diagnostic is useful but less mechanism-centric and would confound interpretation against the new PaiNN evidence; proposal_006 already covers one bounded objective interaction while retaining M01.

Readout-only invariant adapter is a weaker diagnosis-only variant that overlaps with selected late-layer proposal_003; defer it unless the selected M01 placement ablations indicate recurrent feedback is unnecessary.
